summary: Report every read loan by route, the WAL checkpoint state and the replication snapshot build's phases beside the writer-hold objective. New fields in the writer-hold row of /v1/client/request-latency: read_loans (checkouts, snapshot_checkouts, expired, oldest_checkout_age_ms and oldest_snapshot_confirmed_age_ms per route), wal (the newest checkpoint outcome, frames, backfilled, not_backfilled, wal_bytes and deferred_ms) and snapshot_build (wait, inventory and digest windows)

replay.detail: No replay or rebuild; the daemon only records and reports what it already does.

schema.detail: No tables, columns, indexes or triggers.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Additive fields in a diagnostic response; existing fields are unchanged.

downtime.detail: A daemon restart to install the build; no extra interruption.

recovery.detail: Swap back to the previous binary freely; nothing new is persisted.
